About

Pharmaceutical Formulation Scientist with 4+ years of experience in formulation development, process optimization and product development, with strong expertise in solid oral dosage forms and specialized experience in bilayer tablet formulation.

I work with Quality by Design (QbD), Design of Experiments (DoE), formulation optimization, risk assessment, stability studies and scale-up, building robust and reproducible formulations. My hands-on experience covers immediate-release and modified-release tablets, including monolayer and bilayer designs: excipient selection, compatibility assessment, compression development, stability evaluation and technology transfer.

I’m particularly interested in bilayer tablet technology: layer-wise development, weight and compression optimization, interlayer compatibility, mechanical properties, drug release, and preventing layer separation, capping and cross-contamination. Recently I’ve been focusing on AI-assisted formulation research, literature mining and data-driven R&D decisions.

My goal is to bridge pharmaceutical science, data-driven development and practical manufacturing to deliver high-quality, innovative, patient-centric formulations in line with ICH and regulatory expectations.

Music · Gaan Pagol Mizan

Beyond the lab, I’m a singer-songwriter who performs as Gaan Pagol Mizan, with G.P Mizan-Topu as the short form of that name. I write the lyrics, set the tune and sing, and I play acoustic guitar.

My song “Chondrobindu” is in the folk style of Chittagong’s regional folk tradition. I wrote, composed and sang it, with music direction by S.K. Sameer, and it was released in 2017 under the CMV banner, presented by Shahed. It was covered by Kaler Kantho (3 Sep 2017) and Daily Ittefaq.
